newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutz sees end of oper losses in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Deutz sees end of oper losses in 1997.

text.p: German engineering group Deutz AG said on Tuesday it expected a long string of losses in operative businesses to come to an end this year.
Chairman Anton Schneider told a news conference that the company made an operating loss of 56 million marks ($32.4 million) in 1996, but that there would be no losses in 1997.
He said he expected improved operating results in 1998 but that economic developments this year could pose a potential risk to the company's outlook.
"We can already check off the first half (of 1997) as satisfactory," he said.
